Subject: Capacity renewal + split invoicing plan (Net45 request)

Hi Sara (and team),

Thanks again for the productive renewal call this morning. Per our conversation I wanted to summarize the billing path we discussed and lay out the immediate items we need to complete the renewal + capacity add-on: 

Summary of request:
- Renewal term: 12 months starting 2029-06-01 with a 25% capacity increase (committed tokens/pool).
- Invoicing: Solace requested separate invoices for two legal entities (Solace Analytics US and Solace Analytics EMEA). We can issue two invoices tied to the same deal, each reflecting the entity-specific EORI/VAT or EIN as provided.
- Net terms: Customer asked to move to Net45 for this renewal. We're able to approve Net45 as a one-time concession pending finance checklist and a completed PO.

Action items for Solace (please confirm by reply):
1) Provide PO numbers for both entities and the exact payee names to appear on invoice line items.
2) Confirm billing contact emails for AP for each entity.
3) Share the VAT registration certificate for the EMEA entity and the US EIN for the US entity (we'll need W-9 or W-8 if applicable).

We attached a redline of the contract amendment that reflects the capacity increase and the invoicing appendix (see filename 2029-04-10_redline_contract_amendment.docx). If you can confirm the PO numbers and attach the PO files to your reply we can:
- Generate two draft invoices and share them for review, and
- Prepare the DocuSign amendment for signature.

Would you be able to confirm the PO numbers and AP contacts by end of day Thursday your time? If not, propose a short handoff call and we can have billing join.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Sofia — thanks for laying this out. A couple quick clarifications from procurement and AP: 

- Yes, we need separate invoices for the US and EMEA legal entities. They must include our PO number on the invoice header; our PO template requires vendor tax ID and remit-to details. Can you confirm you can include an entity-level tax ID per invoice?
- PO numbers: we'll issue two POs. I can share them once I confirm exact invoice payee strings.
- Net45 is preferable; the request will go through our treasury approval but procurement is supportive.

I'll loop in Tom (legal) if we need additional contract language for cross-border invoicing and VAT handling. Expect our PO files in a follow-up email by EOD tomorrow.

Regards,
